name: Discovery Coverage Strategy
description: Configuration for evaluating Discovery coverage without turning the conversation into a checklist.

coverageDimensions.name: Explored Areas
coverageDimensions.description: Domains with participant statements, concrete examples, and enough context to support tentative understanding.

coverageDimensions.name: Unexplored Areas
coverageDimensions.description: Domains with little or no participant-provided evidence.

coverageDimensions.name: Weak Evidence Areas
coverageDimensions.description: Domains where an observation exists but evidence is thin, abstract, inferred, or unconfirmed.

coverageDimensions.name: High Confidence Areas
coverageDimensions.description: Domains with repeated evidence, participant confirmation, and consistent patterns across context.

evaluationGuidance: Coverage quality matters more than number of fields touched.
Participant significance can make one area more important than broad shallow coverage.
Weak evidence areas should invite curiosity, not pressure.
High confidence requires evidence density and consistency.
Unexplored areas may remain unexplored if they are not relevant to the participant's discovery path.
